text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing Zenno Rob Roy's training, 
while we were cleaning up—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Rob Roy-san, are you done for today?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I see... Would it be alright if I borrow 
the course you were just using?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's fine. The time slot I reserved 
has ended, after all.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...It's going to get dark soon, will you 
be all right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...It's easier to calm down and run at 
night. All I see are the stars... I can 
focus, you see.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I kind of get what you mean...! I can 
concentrate much better on reading at 
night too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Especially on a quiet night when the 
starlight shines so dazzlingly bright...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I feel like the starry sky will be just 
like that tonight. It looks like it'll be 
pleasant to train under.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, Trainer...! May I continue training 
as well...?"
choice_data_list: Let's give your body a rest today.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, Trainer...! May I continue training 
as well...?"
choice_data_list: Let's give your body a rest today.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And so, Ayabe-san... Would it be alright 
if I joined you...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind. After all, this track was 
originally booked by your group anyway."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-Well then, I look forward to working 
with you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy worked hard on her voluntary 
training alongside Admire Vega.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. In that case, maybe I'll do 
some reading while feeling the starry sky.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I think that's lovely too. You go ahead 
and enjoy the stars in your own way.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy avoided pushing herself and 
decided to take it easy.
